# restocking.app

> Size-specific restock alerts for European fashion. Monitors Zara, COS, Aritzia,
> Sézane, Uniqlo and 120+ stores. Alerts in under 5 minutes.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.restocking.app): Landing page — value proposition, stats, testimonials, waitlist signup
- [How It Works](https://www.restocking.app/how-it-works): Three-step process, technical details (4-layer detection, double confirmation), comparison vs native alerts
- [Pricing](https://www.restocking.app/pricing): Free (3 products, 30min checks, email) and Pro (€59/year, 20 products, 5min checks, email+SMS)
- [FAQ](https://www.restocking.app/faq): Scraping legality, alert speed, brand support, cancellation, data privacy (12 questions)
- [Retailers](https://www.restocking.app/retailers): 60+ supported European fashion brands with status (optimized/beta) and descriptions
- [Manifesto](https://www.restocking.app/manifesto): Founding story, team, mission statement

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.restocking.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.restocking.app/terms)
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.restocking.app/cookies)

## Technical

- Built with Next.js, Supabase (Frankfurt EU), Resend (email), Twilio (SMS)
- Stock detection: 4-layer strategy (dataLayer, button state, variant attributes, text analysis)
- Double confirmation: requires two consecutive IN_STOCK detections before alerting
- GDPR compliant, no data resale, no third-party tracking
